description_en: Queries the backup parameters of an SAP HANA database
description_zh: 查询SAP HANA数据库的备份参数
name: DescribeHanaBackupSetting

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the call is successful

CatalogBackupParameterFile.description_en: The configuration file for catalog backup

CatalogBackupUsingBackint.description_en:
Indicates whether Backint is used to back up catalogs. Valid values:

true: Backint is used to back up catalogs.
false: Backint is not used to back up catalogs
CatalogBackupUsingBackint.description_zh:
Catalog备份使用Backint。
true：使用Backint。
false：不使用Backint

DataBackupParameterFile.description_en: The configuration file for data backup

EnableAutoLogBackup.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic log backup is enabled. Valid values:

true: Automatic log backup is enabled.
false: Automatic log backup is disabled
EnableAutoLogBackup.description_zh:
是否开启自动日志备份。
true：开启自动日志备份。
false：不开启自动日志备份

LogBackupParameterFile.description_en: The configuration file for log backup

LogBackupTimeout.description_en: The interval at which logs are backed up. Unit: seconds
LogBackupTimeout.description_zh: 日志备份时间间隔，单位秒

LogBackupUsingBackint.description_en:
Indicates whether Backint is used to back up logs. Valid values:

true: Backint is used to back up logs.
false: Backint is not used to back up logs
LogBackupUsingBackint.description_zh:
是否日志备份到Backint。

true：日志备份到Backint。
false：不备份到Backint

Message.description_en: The message that is returned. If the call is successful, "successful" is returned. If the call fails, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh: 返回信息描述，成功一般返回successful，错误时会返回相应错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功。

true：成功
false：失败
